description: Get the status and (if completed) output URL of a task by id. Use to resume after a webhook, a polling timeout, or a generation started with wait:false. Pass wait:true to block until it finishes.

task_id.description: The task_id returned by a previous generation call.

wait.description: Set true to block until the task reaches a final state (completed/failed) and return the result, instead of returning the current status immediately.

name: get_task
title: Get task status
